description: This file defines the BlackfireDumper class in the Twig Profiler namespace, responsible for dumping profiling data in a specific format for Blackfire integration. It extends the profiling functionality by traversing Profile objects and generating a report string.

classes.name: BlackfireDumper
classes.description: Final class that provides methods to dump profiling data into a Blackfire-compatible format, including recursive traversal of profile data and formatting.

methods.name: dump
methods.description: Public method that initiates the dump process, producing a string representation of the profile data according to the Blackfire format.

methods.name: dumpChildren
methods.description: Private recursive method that processes child profiles and appends their data to the dump structure.

methods.name: dumpProfile
methods.description: Private method that aggregates data for a given profile node, updating the data array with call count, duration, memory usage, and peak memory usage.
